objective: 冻结R65的model×configuration多流图修正公式，在未见page与全新endpoint tuple上进行生产Mooncake RDMA物理fresh-blind验证；禁止训练、重校准和使用blind target调参。
execution_model: external fresh topology inventory; 48 sequential GPU shards; frozen-model CPU aggregation with no fitting

research_scope.wave_admission: all ranks and all graph edges ready before synchronized release
research_scope.decision_scope: none; P/D counts, routing, payload, model and placement are frozen inputs

runtime_inputs: S=sum of all edge curve costs
forbidden: using matched-solo or blind actual latency as an inference input

baseline_contract.comparison_policy: R65 must improve both max-edge and frozen R61 graph extension overall, and improve the better baseline in every configuration

blind_payload_contract.opening_policy: payload definitions were frozen before Phase66 raw; GPU targets are first opened only after R65 froze the formula

topology_definitions.L1: one physical node, four or five launched GPU ranks per shard
topology_definitions.L2: two physical nodes in one rack/network domain, four or five launched GPU ranks per shard
topology_definitions.L3: two physical nodes in different racks but one RDMA domain, four or five launched GPU ranks per shard

resource_allocation_contract.endpoint_slots: A0-A3/B0-B3 are eight GPU slots, not eight nodes
resource_allocation_contract.scheduling: all 48 shards are independent and must run sequentially; four reserved nodes are only a placement pool

fresh_placement_contract.every_phase66_endpoint_tuple_fresh: every (host, physical_gpu, ib_device) tuple in the Phase66 inventory must be absent from all Phase64 measurement ranks
fresh_placement_contract.replicas_distinct: the two Phase66 endpoint signatures within each topology must differ
fresh_placement_contract.host_signature_definition: sorted physical host set used by one placement; one host for L1 and two hosts for L2/L3
fresh_placement_contract.selection_source: scheduler/asset host, rack and fabric metadata only; never benchmark speed, R65 prediction or observed latency
fresh_placement_contract.claim_boundary: all endpoint tuples are fresh; at least one of two placements per topology also has a host signature unseen in Phase64

transport_contract.wave_concurrency: one thread per simultaneous outbound edge on a sender, with per-sender barrier and global gloo release

measurement_contract.wave_latency_semantic: maximum sender-side synchronous call latency across all concurrently admitted graph edges
measurement_contract.data_validation: outside timed intervals verify every destination byte after each mode
measurement_contract.official_point_policy: median across repeats inside each replica, then maximum actual concurrent latency across two pre-frozen fresh replicas
measurement_contract.raw_storage: all JSONL and per-iteration samples remain outside Git

fresh_blind_acceptance_gate.selection: mechanical evaluation only; failure is retained honestly and never triggers refit on blind labels

container_contract.required_gpu_class: CUDA GPU with GPUDirect RDMA; NVIDIA A51 B200 is acceptable

claim_boundary: Phase66 is fresh-blind physical validation of the frozen R65 correction for exactly the two measured models and four at-most-four-flow configurations
a PASS supports unseen-payload and fresh-endpoint generalization across measured L1/L2/L3
it does not support unseen models, larger/different communication graphs, end-to-end serving, compute, memory, queueing, unrelated-job congestion, online arrivals or scheduler placement selection
stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not exact W66 or any pinned input differs
any Phase64 development page is measured or any R65 coefficient/threshold is changed
topology inventory is not frozen before raw, reuses a Phase64 endpoint tuple, or lacks one unseen host signature per topology
an executor requests more than two simultaneous active nodes or five GPU processes for one shard
production Mooncake RDMA/dma-buf is unavailable or falls back to TCP, MNNVL, NVLink bypass, staging or custom pool
model weights, inference, training, downloads, protected raw/cache/PID assets are accessed
raw would enter Git or an existing Phase66 result directory would be overwritten
